origins.title: Where visitors come from
origins.hint: Counted per browser and per play, from the page a visitor arrived from before their first play, and the country Cloudflare saw the address in. Our own links, in magenta, are tagged, since a QR code or a link opened from a messenger brings no referrer. Joiners from before the tags are inferred: no referrer, in a party another browser started.

viaHint.qr: Scanned the QR code of a running party (/join/CODE?qr)
viaHint.link: Opened a party link copied with “Copy link” (/join/CODE?l)
viaHint.join: Opened a party's join URL without a tag: typed off the screen, passed on from the address bar, or an older link
viaHint.inferred: From before the links were tagged: no referrer, playing in a party another browser started, so almost certainly an invitee who scanned the QR code or opened a join link. Inferred, not recorded.
viaHint.share: Opened a song link a singer shared from SingSpree (/sing/ID?r=CODE): a score card, share video or recording

origins.noCountries: Countries are stored with each play from this release on, so this fills up from here.

devices.title: What they sing on
devices.hint: Operating system (with its version, where the browser tells it), browser and kind of device of everyone who sang in this window, read off the user agent stored with each play and, since October 4, 2026, the system version the browser reports itself; counted per browser and per play. A user agent cannot tell everything: an iPad asking for the desktop site says it is a Mac, and Brave says it is Chrome.
devices.versionHiddenHint: The browser hides the system version in its user agent (Chrome on Android, Safari and Firefox on a Mac). Chromium browsers report it with each play since October 4, 2026; older plays and other browsers stay unknown.
devices.windowsHint: Windows 10 and 11 send the same user agent; only Chromium browsers say which one, with plays since October 4, 2026.
devices.notRecordedHint: Plays from before April 25, 2026, when the user agent was not stored yet

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.hint: How people like SingSpree. A small card in the corner asks once a browser has been through three songs to the end, as host or singer: on the score screen or on the home page, at most three times, never during a song. The stars are kept as soon as they are tapped; the comment comes after. Shown to counts browsers; Closed with ✕ is a ✕ before any star, Let it pass the rest (the card went away untouched). These two are counted since October 29, 2026, so answers from before that have no showing behind them.

shares.title: Share links
shares.hint: Every score card, share video and recording a singer shares carries a random code (singspree.com/sing/ID?r=CODE); the server knows whose it is. Links: codes handed out, one per thing shared. Sent: times the share sheet took one or its file was downloaded. Arrivals: browsers that opened one, once per link, never the sharer's own. What those browsers did within 30 days of arriving: started a party, sang a song, made an account.
